payload.name: Arousal as a mediator of scarcity effects

decision_note: NOT_TRANSFERABLE — this is a claim about an internal mediating psychological state (arousal), not an independently actionable effect; its lever (countdown timer, limited-stock indicator) duplicates the already-approved scarcity-cue effects without adding a distinct mechanism a product can act on.

checks.reason: no person and no artifact named — the subject is a system, construct, or phenomenon, which is neither of the two subjects a transferable claim can have

names a manipulable variable: countdown timer with limited-stock indicator — names a manipulable variable: countdown timer with limited-stock indicator — Scarcity cues via timers and stock counts drive arousal, a UI-controllable mechanism.
states a structural relation (mediating) but no direction — a path is not an instruction
no specialist population named — the claim does not require expertise to apply
